title: Hearty Malty Turkish Celeriac Menemen
description: A malty, fluffy, nostalgic Turkish dish featuring celeriac, kombu-cold-extract, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients, served in a menemen form.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together malt flour, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add diced celeriac to the skillet and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and kombu cold extract.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked celeriac and stir gently.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Toast some gluten-free bread and serve on the side.
Optional: add some crumbled feta cheese on top for extra flavor.
